card.name: Drug interaction sentences naming a second drug
card.fires_on: Words inside drug-interaction advice, just after one drug is named and a second interacting drug is about to be named or the dose change is stated. Includes 'and' between drug names, or the start of a drug name.

modes.label: Dose adjustment wording
modes.description: Verb about changing a dose when drugs are combined.
modes.example: The dose of lamotrigine should be<< reduced>> when co-administered with valpro

modes.label: Joining a second drug
modes.description: 'and', 'with' or a partial drug name linking the first drug to the one it interacts with.
modes.example: Coadministration with saxagliptin<< and>> metformin hydrochloride extended-release

modes.label: Inside an interacting drug's name
modes.description: Early pieces of a drug name that is part of the interaction statement.
modes.example: limit the maximum single dose of z<<ol>>mitriptan tablets to 2
